# DrionTune

> No-root Android gaming & performance optimizer powered by Shizuku (Android 11–16) with an optional Windows PC Edition that requires no Shizuku.

- Landing Page: https://gwenz2.github.io/DrionTune/

- Support Email: gwenny252@gmail.com

## What DrionTune Does
- **Zero Background Drain:** Runs only when opened; does not leave an accessibility service or background daemon eating CPU/battery during matches.
- **1-Click Fix Lag (Free):** Monitors live CPU, RAM, ZRAM, and battery temperature and stops background hog processes.
- **Game Launcher & App Freezer (Free):** Suspends selected background apps (social media, shopping, messaging) to 0% CPU and 0 MB RAM while gaming, with 1-tap Restore All Apps. Accounts and logins stay intact.
- **Safe Bloatware Remover (Pro):** Reversibly hides pre-installed carrier and OEM bloatware for User 0 without modifying the system partition or tripping warranty/Knox.
- **Deep Gaming Tweaks (Pro):** Disables window blurs, reduces background Wi-Fi scan ping spikes (Cloudflare DNS), disables Samsung GOS, tunes Samsung RAM Plus, and supports thermal throttling override when an active cooler is attached. Includes 1-tap Reset Everything.

## Upcoming v1.1.4 Update
- **Free:** Screen Resolution Scale (90% / 80% / 70% / 50% Extreme) with 15-second auto-revert confirmation, Shizuku v13.6.0 Step 3 direct-process auto-fix for Transsion/MediaTek/Android 15–16, per-game FPS target, ART shader pre-compile, zero-RAM Restore notification, and automatic update alerts.
- **Pro:** Hardware-verified Lock Max Refresh Rate (90/120Hz), Soft Background Throttle (AppOps), Custom Debloater (All Apps search with core OS protection), and Per-Game Auto Profiles.

## Shizuku Step 3 Troubleshooting Summary
- **OPPO / Realme / OnePlus (ColorOS / Realme UI / OxygenOS):** Enable Developer Options -> Disable permission monitoring, then restart Shizuku. Fixes "Shizuku: The permission of adb is limited".
- **Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO (MIUI / HyperOS):** Enable Developer Options -> USB debugging (Security settings), set Battery saver to No restrictions, and enable Autostart for Shizuku and DrionTune.
- **Tecno / Infinix / Itel (HiOS / XOS):** Keep USB debugging ON alongside Wireless debugging, allow Shizuku & DrionTune in Phone Master Auto-start, and enable Disable permission monitoring if shown.
- **Alternative (No Shizuku):** Use DrionTune Windows PC Edition via USB cable or Wireless Debugging QR pairing.
